name: Boardroom Full
_why: A real-size panel (docs/from-scratch.md section 5c). 23 pages, all reached from Welcome; the Volume group shown on seven pages, each through its own popup_ref; the Keypad group at a different place on each of two pages; three modals, two shown by the program; Home, the status line, Room Off and the volume tabs mirrored under one ID each on every page that carries them.
_seed: Built against seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl, so Open Sans.
does: After ten minutes without a touch, close any popup and return to Welcome.
